corrections.bio: Jeremy Rodrigues (Yale Law ’26, Schwarzman ’23) is a founder, Air Force Reserve Captain, and Pokémon International Champion. Legal AI incumbents are competing over the sliver of legal claims that ever reach a lawyer; he’s building Gideon for the ~100% that never will — starting in prisons, where the gap is most extreme. Gideon is an AI voice agent that turns a phone call into a correctly filed grievance — one that reaches independent oversight and preserves a legal claim that would otherwise be quietly waived. It launches in September 2026 across every Connecticut state prison, serving over 10,000 people.

corrections.bio: Matei Coldea is a Yale junior studying Computer Science and Electrical Engineering. Over the past four years he has worked on robotics and embedded systems: at Accenture as an intern, then at Lenovo, where he built CSI-based wireless sensing systems combined with AI. He founded Verlet Robotics, where he built an advanced robotics lab from the ground up in East Africa, a region with no existing infrastructure for robotics or AI research, and where the team now collects teleoperation, UMI, and egocentric data at scale. On top of that he built the full data processing pipeline: motion retargeting, annotation tooling with reusable primitives like MANO hand-pose correction, and the operational software that keeps the whole thing running. With the Apollo Lab at Yale he has co-authored several papers spanning robot sensing, batch sampling methods, and most recently a CoRL 2026 paper on segmenting what a robot attends to using its attention matrices and task objective, aimed at improving VLAs and world models. He is also one of the main contributors to the MathWorks-sponsored Neuron project, where he built advanced visualization and approximation methods for neuron analysis.

corrections.bio: Sofia Teifeld is a Yale College ’29 founding team member and COO of CHET, an investing-first Mastercard designed for students and young professionals. The card automatically invests 0.7% of every purchase into a user-selected ETF, with merchant-funded rewards of up to 10%. By combining everyday spending, credit building, and automatic investing, CHET makes it easier for young consumers to start building wealth without needing prior investing experience. She is also Co-Director of LAUNCH at the Yale Entrepreneurial Society.
